title: Remove the last IT company
description:
Remove the last IT company from the list.

Python-Gym adaptation: implement as remove_last_company(companies), returning a new list without the last item.
hints: Slicing can stop just before the last item of a list.
A slice ending at -1 leaves out the final item.
expected_behavior: Returns a new list with the last item removed.
explanation: companies[:-1] slices from the start up to (but not including) the last item.
